name: subagent-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt plus an agents panel (/subagent-progress) for any subagent work: running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time, each drawn as a crab whose costume follows its model and effort. Fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit savvy-progress 1.2.0.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: follow uses Agent-Pulse's palette (ember when it is not installed); ember is Claude's warm orange range, claude follows your theme, neon is bioluminescent sea colors, mono keeps color for what needs you. Colors the terminal band's bar; the crabs keep their costume colors

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: follow uses Agent-Pulse's level (subtle when it is not installed); off keeps the terminal still, subtle walks the crabs and pulses the bar, full also moves their props and sparkles when the work is done. The desktop drawings are unchanged
